John Stuart Mill, The Subjection of Women.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/john-stuart-mill/the-subjection-of-women

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- John Stuart Mill, the author, died 1873 (United Kingdom (first published London, 1869)).

First publication of the text used: 1869 (colophon: 'published in 1869 by John Stuart Mill').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1869, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1964.
- Country of origin (United Kingdom (first published London, 1869)): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years
  after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die
  did so in 1873, so the work entered the public domain there on
  1 January 1944.
